item.title: Texas Rangers sports firm acquires Long Island Ducks
item.description: REV Entertainment, the Texas Rangers’ sports arm, has acquired the Long Island Ducks, the Atlantic League’s winningest and most attended team.

item.title: Melville lawyer pleads guilty to stealing $413K in client funds
item.description: Melville-attorney pleaded guilty to grand larceny after stealing $413,237 in client funds tied to a real estate loan payoff

item.title: For real estate in the Hamptons, the priciest get even pricier
item.description: Hamptons home prices hit new records in Q4 as luxury sales soar, with median prices up over 30% year over year, according to new report.

item.title: Long Island investment firm acquires another retail center

item.title: Why storytelling drives nonprofit fundraising and advocacy
item.description: Storytelling helps nonprofits boost fundraising, influence lawmakers and show economic impact by pairing data with personal narratives that move donors.

item.description: Conflicts between presidents and the Federal Reserve date back centuries, underscoring why Fed independence remains vital to economic stability.
